The '''''Diamond''-class cruiser''', also known as '''''Diamond''-class courier ship''' and the '''Commerce Guild cruiser''', was a [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] used by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] prior to and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:DiamondClassCruiserAftPort-FF116.png|thumb|left|180px|An aft, port side view of a ''Diamond''-class cruiser]]
Manufactured by the Commerce Guild, this cruiser served as a rapid deployment carrier for [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droids]] and [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]]. Capable of carrying thousands of spider [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] into combat, the ''Diamond''-class cruiser was a valuable asset for the Commerce Guild. The cruiser was armed lightly, though upon leaving the [[Transport/Legends|transport]], the cruiser's droids could provide cover fire during takeoff.

==History==
An arc-shaped vessel powered by three sublight drives, the ''Diamond''-class cruiser became part of the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Separatist starfleet]] in the lead-up to the Clone Wars. Over forty Commerce Guild transports were present at the outbreak of the Clone Wars on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], having transported war machines and Guild officials to the official forming of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

<div style="float:right">[[File:Diamond_BG.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A ''Diamond''-class cruiser rests in the background during the chaos of the Battle of Geonosis (lower far right).]]</div>
When the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] invaded the Separatist stronghold, Commerce Guild pilots immediately prepared their vessels for lift off, gathering up as much of their cargo as they could. Of the forty-one transports docked on Geonosis, thirty-six escaped the battle to regroup and rejoin the war.

[[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]] would use mainly ''Diamond''-class ships as transports in her successful campaign against the Republic to acquire the [[Decimator (war machine)|Decimator]] and seize [[Sarapin/Legends|Sarapin]].

==Behind the scenes==
Commerce Guild starships are briefly seen during the chaos of the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], docked behind exploding [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|IG-227 ''Hailfire''-class droid tanks]] as the conflict rages. These ships are also seen as static objects in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''.
